title: Presidential Determination Pursuant to Section 1245(d)(4)(B) and (C) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2012
Airworthiness Directives; The Boeing Company Airplanes
summary: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain The Boeing Company Model 787-8 airplanes. This proposed AD was prompted by a report that certain wing skin outer mold line (OML) penetrating fasteners installed using threaded nuts without cap seals do not provide reliable protection against potential ignition sources when subjected to direct attachment lightning currents. This proposed AD would require inspecting between certain ribs on the left and right wing for wing skin penetrating fasteners with a threaded nut adjacent to the electromagnetic effects (EME) sleeve; inspecting the left and right wing fuel tanks, surge tanks, and dry bays for threaded nuts installed on fasteners that penetrate the upper and lower wing skins; accomplishing the inspection specified in a certain airworthiness limitation (AWL); and applicable on-condition actions. This proposed AD would also require accomplishing concurrent requirements and revising the maintenance program to incorporate the airworthiness limitation task. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

Additionally, this action corrects the header format to conform with current FAA policy. Lastly, this action updates the outdated term "Airport/Facility Directory" to "Chart Supplement." title: Request for Information
summary: The National Center for Education Evaluation (NCEE), a center within the U.S. Department of Education's Institute of Education Sciences (IES), is charged (20 U.S.C. 9561(b)(2)) with evaluating how effectively States and local agencies implement the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) and provide early intervention services to infants and toddlers with disabilities and a free appropriate public education to children and youth with disabilities. In carrying out these activities, NCEE, in collaboration with the National Center for Special Education Research (NCSER), has identified six aspects of IDEA implementation for consideration of evaluation: access; appropriate services and educational outcomes; procedural safeguards; statewide systems, accountability, and flexibility; fiscal and resource effectiveness; and national activities. Through this request for information (RFI), NCEE seeks public input to identify key questions for future evaluation studies.

title: Crystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cells, Whether or Not Assembled Into Modules, From the People's Republic of China: Notice of Court Decision Not in Harmony With the Results of Antidumping Administrative Review; Notice of Amended Final Results
summary: On October 29, 2026, the U.S. Court of International Trade (CIT) issued its final judgment in Jinko Solar Import and Export Co., Ltd., et. al. v. United States, Consol. Court no. 22-00219, sustaining the U.S. Department of Commerce's (Commerce) third remand results pertaining to the administrative review of the antidumping duty (AD) order on crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells, whether or not assembled into modules, from the People's Republic of China covering the period December 1, 2019, through November 30, 2020 (2019-2020 AD administrative review). Commerce is notifying the public that the CIT's final judgment is not in harmony with the final results of the 2019-2020 AD administrative review. Thus, Commerce is amending the final results of that review by recalculating the dumping margins for Jinko, Risen, JA Solar Technology Yangzhou Co., Ltd. (JA Solar Yangzhou), Shanghai JA Solar Technology Co., Ltd. (Shanghai JA Solar), and BYD (Shangluo) Industrial Co., Ltd. (BYD).

title: Hunting and Shooting Sports Conservation and Access Council; Request for Nominations
summary: The U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI) is seeking member nominations to the Hunting and Shooting Sports Conservation and Access Council (Council). Individuals who submitted a cover letter and resume in response to the April 21, 2026, and October 7, 2026, request for nominations do not need to resubmit for this request. The Council will provide recommendations to the Federal Government, through the Secretary of the Interior (Secretary) and the Secretary of Agriculture, regarding the establishment and implementation of existing and proposed policies and authorities with regard to wildlife and habitat conservation endeavors that benefit wildlife resources; encourage partnership among the public, sporting conservation organizations, and Federal, State, Tribal, and Territorial governments; benefit hunting and the shooting sports; and increase public access to hunting and the shooting sports.

title: Safety Zone; Massachusetts Bay, Boston, MA
summary: The Coast Guard is establishing temporary moving safety zones for certain portions of the navigable water of Massachusetts Bay, 22 miles northeast of Boston, MA.
